''See also: [[The Testament Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Testament is a unique and highly specialized vessel used by the [[Guild]], recognized as the fastest ship in its fleet due to its ability to travel in straight lines regardless of tides or [[wind]]. The ship features a dark green, nearly black wooden hull adorned with gold lettering and lacks traditional sails; instead, it utilizes a mast that resembles a leafless tree and sails crafted from what appears to be stretched [[Elder skin]]. Its construction is seamless, with decks and planks merged into a single cohesive whole. Functioning as a [[Soulbound Vessel]], the ship possesses a sentient quality that creates a mental bond with its captain, Imperial Steward Calder Marten{{!}}Calder Marten. This connection allows the ship to act as a second mind that can experience emotions like panic or eagerness, sometimes even struggling with its owner for control. While designed to carry significant amounts of cargo and passengers in various cabins, the ship is also capable of being operated by a very small crew through the use of [[Intent]]. A defining characteristic of The Testament is its connection to a massive, ancient entity known as the [[Lyathatan]]. This [[Elderspawn]] is bound to the underside of the hull by [[chains]], serving as a powerful engine that pulls the vessel through the ocean. While this provides immense speed, the creature is resentful of its servitude to humans and possesses a desire for absolute dominion over the sea floor.}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|The Testament is a dark green Awakened ship featuring green-veined sails made of membranous skin that resemble bat's wings. Imperial Steward Calder Marten{{!}}Captain Calder [[Marten]] repaired the vessel using three hundred planks of wood, and he has kept tools disguised as materials hidden in his carriage while working at the ship's scaffolding-covered work site. This fast [[Guild]] vessel is designed to be pulled by an [[Elderspawn]] and serves as a [[Blackwatch]] ship equipped with cannons, cabins, and a hold filled with cargo. While [[Urzaia Woodsman]] serves as the official cook for the crew and prisoners, the ship also functions as a potential escape option that is expected to make landfall soon.}}

== Of Dawn and Darkness ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The Testament is a sailing vessel that the Emperor has invested thousands of [[goldmarks]] into, an artifact previously mentioned by Cheska Bennett{{!}}Cheska. After [[Calder]] attempted to tip the object, the group eventually took possession of the ship, which was filled to capacity with salvaged cargo. Thirteen people used the boat to leave [[Silverreach]], though its crew was later taken prisoner by the [[Sleepless]]. [[Calder]] used [[Reading]] to keep the construction together and intended to use the moving vessel to flee, even as [[Petal]] remained aboard. While the ship features a railing and could potentially be sunk by Jorin Curse-breaker{{!}}Jorin, it remains a force that can be capsized like a crashing wave and is large enough for an [[Inquisitor]] to be sneaked into.}}

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Testament is a vessel located near the harbor that is subject to restrictions preventing a [[Soulbound]] from bringing it into a meeting room. While Dalton Foster{{!}}Foster maintains a cabin on the ship, [[Dalton Foster]] attempts to bring the vessel close to shore through the [[shallow Aion]]. Although the ship is described as being half a wreck with waves lapping against its hull, it responds to [[Calder]]'s presence and emits a pure light from its deck. The arrival of the crew-only ship is viewed as a godsend, and [[Calder]] hurries back to the location as the group plans to board.}}
